sheets.title: 5kV ONE-LINE DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet 5kV medium-voltage one-line diagram for Military Highway Recycling facility in Chesapeake, VA. Produced by Bowman Foster & Associates (BFA), project number 21-011, plot date May 10, 2021. Drawn by RTD, checked by M°D, Project Engineer MLD. Utility source is Dominion Power underground cables at 13.2 kV. Service enters via (2) 5" conduit (4 kV) feeder by Dominion Power into a metering cabinet. From metering cabinet, (3) 6" conduit feeders by Dominion Power route to a Dominion Power transformer. From transformer, (2) 4" conduit feeders by Dominion Power. Downstream distribution: (1) BENSHAW 2200VAC fused switch (rated continuous current 120A, application load 400A) and (1) BENSHAW 4200VAC starter (rated continuous current 120A, application load 1000HP). Both feed (3) #70 5kV conductors in conduit to a Westinghouse Lifeline D-type LAC induction motor rated 800HP, 4160V, 3-phase, 98 FLA. The diagram is labeled 'NO SCALE.' BFA seal/stamp visible in title block. Contract number field blank. The drawing appears to be the sole design deliverable for this engagement.

electrical: Dominion Power 13.2 kV underground cable service
Westinghouse Lifeline D-type LAC induction motor — 800HP, 4160V, 3-phase, 98 FLA
